title: Robot embodiments
purpose: Robot adapters exposing a joint-space action contract and observations.

requirements.title: G1 humanoid embodiment adapter
requirements.why: The free-base humanoid is the reference embodiment

acceptance.text: The G1 adapter reports joint_pos actions over the 29 actuated joints plus pelvis pose in observations
Observations include pelvis IMU (gyro and accel), joint state, and touch-sensor normal forces on pelvis, torso, elbows, hands, shins, and feet

requirements.title: A second registered embodiment proves the slot
requirements.why: Two robots with different action spaces is what makes the contract real

acceptance.text: A Franka Panda adapter registers an 8-D joint_pos action space (7 joints plus gripper)
The scripted policy completes a tabletop pick on the Franka adapter in under 60 simulated seconds

requirements.title: Action guardrails on every policy
requirements.why: A policy that commands out-of-bounds motion is clamped, not trusted

acceptance.text: Actions outside the embodiment's declared bounds are clamped before reaching physics
Per-step action deltas are limited to a fraction of each joint's range, and disabling guardrails requires an explicit flag
